svg.font-family: Times New Roman, Tinos, Liberation Serif, serif
svg.title: Construction and evaluation of a mechanism-grounded TF–gene benchmark
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction of the user-supplied four-panel benchmark figure. All visible text is retained as SVG text, and all diagrams are independent vector paths and shapes. No raster image, embedded font, script, or external asset is included. Panels A–D and their components are named groups.
